label: sonnet
answer:
**When they appear:** only on a *windowed* row, meaning `--max-columns N` is in effect (which requires `--json` or `--queries-file`, src/main.zig:1749-1753), the line is longer than N, and the event has a match to centre on. Otherwise the event is byte-identical to the pre-M9 output (src/out_json.zig:184-186, 77-78). The code emits them only `if (win)` (src/out_json.zig:188-193). Rows with no match span are never cut, so they carry no such fields (src/out_json.zig:526-539).

**Meaning:**
- `win_start`: the byte offset into the line where the windowed `text` begins (src/out_json.zig:187). The window starts at file offset `line_start + win_start` (src/out_json.zig:70-71).
- `line_len`: the full length of the original line, taken from `ev.text.len` (src/out_json.zig:192). The whole line is `file[line_start .. line_start + line_len]` (src/out_json.zig:69-70).

Example: `"win_start":20,"line_len":60` (src/out_json.zig:508).
